pr.title: Add path sanitizer for untrusted filenames

recorded_model_response.review_markdown:
## Summary

The new path sanitizer must not bypass the leading-`-` redaction boundary; the committed source already does the right thing, but the model's own quote carries a `[REDACTED]` marker that has to be verified against exact-head source before this can land.

## Findings

- **Blocker** (`-untrusted/secrets.txt`) — the diff ships a marker that, if not refuted, would commit a sanitizer-placeholder token to a path the deterministic `safeFile` boundary rejects on read.

## Recommendation

Request changes until the marker can be confirmed absent from the exact-head source, and the deterministic required-check is satisfied.
